chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ja'far bin Muhammad al-Ash'ary, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) liked the fresh dates with the melon.

key_terms.الرُّطَبُ: Fresh, soft dates still on the palm

ai.seo_question: What food combination did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) enjoy according to Shia hadith sources?
ai.summary: This brief narration from Al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) preference for combining fresh dates (rutab) with melon (kharbaz), reflecting the Sunnah of enjoying simple, natural foods in harmony. In Shia scholarly tradition, such details underscore the importance of following the Prophet’s dietary habits as a form of worship and health maintenance, emphasizing moderation and appreciation of God’s provisions.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Al Ash’ary, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup>’ liked the dates and the melon.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad al-Ash‘ariy from ibn al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, liked fresh dates with melons.’”
